title: Choose the flagship taste
question: Five taste worlds will ship. This roll assigns the default taste and the grammar the catalog hangs on. Exploration is already a contact sheet: the visitor reads numbered frames of student work. Garden chrome stays on the dashboard. Pick a world, re-roll, or play the category straight.

options.label: Sides / Call sheet
options.lineage: Production call sheets and actor sides on a clipboard
options.thesis: The folio is working paperwork: numbered setups, the still is the shot, the student is a scene header.
options.viewport: A punched manila sheet: shot-list rail on the left, shot 01 still owning the page, name as SCENE / INT. STUDIO — DAY.
options.risk: Can read film-only if the paperwork stays too literal for a painter or coder.

raised.raise: The sheet is already occupied with marks; one calm panel holds the still.
Setup numbers ink in sequence, a marker stroke not a fade.
Opening a frame is irreversible: the still takes the whole sheet.
Every destination is a tick on one shot-list rail; the open one blooms.
Select one setup and dim the rest; confidence is line weight.

options.label: Light table
options.lineage: Darkroom contact sheets on a 5000K light table
options.thesis: The visitor is at the table; student work is film frames, the name is grease pencil.
options.viewport: A glowing table of numbered stills; one frame already larger; bio is a caption strip.
options.risk: The direction most studio-portfolio runs land on, and the exploration we already locked.

options.label: Kiln shelf
options.lineage: A kiln shelf of glazed cups, molten color arrested mid-run
options.thesis: Student pieces sit in one fired row; gravity is the reading order, captions are recipe cards.
options.viewport: A chalk-white shelf: one large still as a thick glaze tear, smaller stills as neighboring cups.
options.case: Holds product clarity (work as samples in a row) and studio identification; loses to call sheets on AFM’s film-and-critique scene.
options.risk: Reads ceramics-department unless the ‘vessels’ are clearly the student’s stills.

options.label: Festival hoarding
options.lineage: Screenprinted street-fair flyers stacked on a hoarding
options.thesis: Every inch is occupied; one calm panel is the only luxury left for the work.
options.viewport: A full-bleed collage with one white finder panel holding a still.
options.case: Loses identification (street fair, not critique) and clarity (grammar bans photography, which is the product).
options.kept: Occupied field with one calm panel for the still.

options.label: Wildstyle blackbook
options.lineage: Marker pages where the name is knitted until barely readable
options.thesis: The name is the map; you have to already know it to read it.
options.viewport: Interlocking letters as navigation, a throw-up in the corner as the fast version.
options.case: Loses both: recruiters cannot parse a name they must already know.
options.kept: Sequential marker-stroke motion for setup numbers.

options.label: Accretion threshold
options.lineage: A black-hole disk at the edge of disappearance
options.thesis: One fragment slows, reddens, and vanishes across an irreversible threshold.
options.viewport: A still crossing a gold ring into unmarked black.
options.case: Loses both: students do not identify with cosmology, and the work disappears.
options.kept: Opening a frame is irreversible; the still takes the sheet.

options.label: Emission-line rail
options.lineage: A glass spectrogram on a 3am viewing box
options.thesis: Every mark hangs off one off-centre rail; colour survives only as hairlines.
options.viewport: A grey band with needle lines; the open tick blooms a giant plate.
options.case: Loses identification (lab night, not studio) and clarity (work fights the hairline law).
options.kept: Destinations are ticks on one rail; the open one blooms.

options.label: Event display
options.lineage: A collider cross-section with tracks blooming through detector rings
options.thesis: One event at a time; pick a track, dim the rest.
options.viewport: Concentric rings with student stills as energy bars on the outer wedges.
options.case: Loses both: physics-lab identification, and the work becomes a plot.
options.kept: Isolate one setup and dim the rest; confidence as line weight.

canonCard.label: Profession templates, played straight
canonCard.thesis: Photographer / Developer / Designer homepages with a resume hero, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Name, title, and CTA above the fold; work in a later grid.
canonCard.risk: The brief refused this: taste not profession, work first. Still the user’s door.
